sentences.text:
The present appeal is filed under section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 to set aside the impugned judgment dated 12.02.2024 passed by the court of Sh. Deepak Dabas, ADJ-01, North District, Rohini Courts, Delhi in LAC bearing no. 382/2019 titled as Bhopal Singh V UOI & Anr.
seeking further enhancement in compensation amount and modification to the extent thereof in the impugned judgment in respect of the award bearing no. 12/2005-06/DC(N-W) pertaining to the Village Barwala, Delhi.
2. Issue notice.
